response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff engineer with broad web, mobile, and systems experience, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no native or apparent Japanese proficiency, no evidence of Linux kernel source modification experience, no C-on-UNIX embedded focus, and no background in the specific security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or networking/switch technologies required. His recent and most substantial experience is in web/full-stack and distributed backend systems rather than embedded firmware or network security, making him a poor match despite his overall technical strength.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated experience with C/C++ in some past roles (NI LabWindows/CVI, embedded audio project)
Strong self-driven learner with open-source, teaching, and workshop track record
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, a mandatory requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No experience with required security/networking domains (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, L2/L3 networking)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security/networking domain experience
Strong general software engineering skill set and C exposure
